item.description:
Aside 1.7.2

Dictation stops guessing the wrong language, and agent access shows you what to say.

Fixed

  • Dictation in the language you speak. Whisper used to decide the language after the first two seconds and never look again, so a filler word or an English term at the start could turn a German sentence into English. It now keeps checking while you talk until it is sure, and checks the whole take once more before inserting. Your fallback language only steps in for a very unsure guess, never over a clear one.

New

  • Try it, right in Settings. With live access on, Settings › Agents shows two phrases you can copy into Claude Code or Codex, including "Follow the meeting and flag decisions".
  • The first time an agent reads a live meeting, the Agents chip on the recording panel suggests "follow the meeting" once, then never again.
  • live_status now tells the agent what to do next, so Codex finds follow mode without a prompt menu.
